title: Hazel and the Verdict
author: Kestrel Lockridge
blurb: Mara Vasquez, a hotel concierge who notices everything, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the statute expires.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
